tab_send_schedule_v2:
Columns: Email ID | Name | Eligible cohort | Trigger (entry condition) | Send time | Holdout / experiment variant | Primary CTA | UTM campaign/content | Success event(s) | Exit criteria | Notes

E0 | Verify + Welcome (transactional) | All new signups | event=signup_completed AND email_verified=false | Immediately (within 2 min) | No experiment | Verify email + open console | utm_campaign=onboarding_v2&utm_content=e0_verify | email_verified | Exit when email_verified=true | Must be classified as transactional; contains support link + security reminders.

E1 | Welcome to Redwood (get API key) | New signups (verified) | signup_completed AND email_verified=true | +15 min after verification OR next send window (see send windows) | A/B subject line (Ben) | Create API key | utm_campaign=onboarding_v2&utm_content=e1_welcome_api_key | api_key_created | Exit when api_key_created=true | Keep concise; 1 code block; emphasize "fast first request".

E2 | You’re 2 minutes from first tokens | Signed up, no API key | signup_completed AND api_key_created=false | T+24h from signup at local send window | A/B CTA button label | Create API key | utm_campaign=onboarding_v2&utm_content=e2_no_key | api_key_created | Exit when api_key_created=true OR user_unsubscribed=true | Include link to console preferences page (ENG-10518).

E3 | Run your first request (copy/paste) | Has API key, no successful request | api_key_created=true AND first_request_success=false | T+6h after api_key_created OR next send window | No experiment (baseline) | Send first request (docs snippet) | utm_campaign=onboarding_v2&utm_content=e3_first_request | first_request_success | Exit when first_request_success=true | Use minimal “hello world” snippet aligned with quickstarts.

E4 | Turn on streaming (better UX) | First request success, streaming not used | first_request_success=true AND streaming_used=false | T+48h after first_request_success | A/B message emphasis (latency vs reliability) | Enable streaming | utm_campaign=onboarding_v2&utm_content=e4_streaming | streaming_used | Exit when streaming_used=true | Keep this as optional; do not block progress.

E5 | Hit 100k tokens (fast path) | Active testers under milestone | first_request_success=true AND tokens_100k_reached=false | T+72h after first_request_success | Holdout 10% (cohort flag) | Run eval / ship small feature | utm_campaign=onboarding_v2&utm_content=e5_100k | tokens_100k_reached | Exit when tokens_100k_reached=true OR d7_inactive=true | Position as milestone to unlock “real performance signal.”

E6 | Costs + usage dashboard | Users who crossed 100k tokens | tokens_100k_reached=true | T+24h after milestone | No experiment | View usage dashboard | utm_campaign=onboarding_v2&utm_content=e6_usage | usage_dashboard_viewed | Exit when usage_dashboard_viewed=true | Introduce cost levers (batching/caching) + console link.

ST1 | Stalled: need a hand? | Signed up, no first request | signup_completed=true AND first_request_success=false | T+5 days from signup | No experiment | Book office hours / support | utm_campaign=onboarding_v2&utm_content=st1_stalled | support_contacted OR first_request_success | Exit on activation or unsubscribe | Soft ask; avoid sounding salesy.

RR1 | Re-engage (light) | Activated once, no return | first_request_success=true AND d7_active=false | T+9 days from first_request_success | No experiment | Try a template / example app | utm_campaign=onboarding_v2&utm_content=rr1_reengage | d7_active | Exit when d7_active=true | Keep to 1 email; do not spam dormant users.

Send windows (to protect engagement):
- Default: 9:30am–11:30am recipient local time (fallback UTC if timezone unknown).
- Backup window: 1:30pm–3:30pm local time.
- No sends: 10pm–6am local time.
- Weekends: allowed for E0/E1 (transactional + welcome) only; otherwise next business day.
tab_trigger_logic_event_based:
Trigger engine: event-based (Segment/warehouse) + feature-flag cohort assignment (pr-28477).

Canonical events / properties (per pr-28431 + dedupe fix pr-28521):
- signup_completed (properties: user_id, email_domain, region, created_at, source, utm_*)
- email_verified (user_id, verified_at)
- api_key_created (user_id, api_key_id, created_at)
- first_request_success (user_id, model, sdk, region, request_id, created_at)
- streaming_used (user_id, sdk, created_at)
- tokens_100k_reached (user_id, reached_at, days_since_signup)
- usage_dashboard_viewed (user_id, created_at)
- user_unsubscribed (user_id, unsubscribed_at, channel=email)

Cohorts (for experiment + holdouts):
- lifecycle_growth_onboarding_email_v2 = {control, variant_a, variant_b}
- holdout_email_onboarding = true/false (global holdout; default false; target 10% holdout for E5)

Dedupe / idempotency rules:
- Each email has a unique "send_key" = user_id + email_id + version.
- Never send same email_id more than once per user (unless explicitly reengage RR1).
- If event arrives late (warehouse lag), skip backfilled sends if user has already met exit criteria.

Exit criteria logic (global):
- If user_unsubscribed=true => stop all non-transactional emails.
- If contact_in_sales_outreach=true => stop ST1/RR1 and notify owner (avoid conflicting touches).
- If hard_bounce=true OR spam_complaint=true => immediate global suppression.

Timezone resolution:
1) user.profile.timezone if present
2) inferred from first console session / IP region mapping
3) fallback UTC
tab_suppression_and_frequency_caps:
Global frequency caps (guardrails):
- Max 1 onboarding email per 24 hours per user (transactional E0 excluded).
- Max 3 onboarding emails per rolling 7 days per user (excludes E0).
- Do not send more than 2 emails total before api_key_created (to reduce early irritation).

Suppression rules (hard):
- user_unsubscribed=true (CAN-SPAM/GDPR)
- hard_bounce=true
- spam_complaint=true
- email_invalid=true (regex + vendor validation)
- role_address=true (e.g., info@, support@) — suppress by default unless explicitly opted in

Suppression rules (soft / conditional):
- contact_in_sales_outreach=true (HubSpot property) => suppress ST1 + RR1; allow E1–E3 only if "lifecycle_emails_allowed=true" (default true). Escalate to Jordan/Stephanie if questions.
- enterprise_domain=true AND opp_stage in {Security review, Legal, Procurement} => suppress RR1 (avoid perception of marketing pressure).
- support_ticket_open_severity>=2 tagged "deliverability" => pause all non-transactional until resolved.

GDPR/consent handling (current approach):
- Treat onboarding as "service communications" post signup, with opt-out always available.
- If explicit marketing_consent=false (where captured) => only send E0/E1/E2/E3 (no RR1 retarget-style re-engage).

Footer + compliance requirements:
- Unsubscribe link required on all non-transactional emails.
- Company address + reason for receiving included.
- Preference center link included (console surface shipped under ENG-10518).

Ops notes:
- Suppression list refresh: hourly.
- Sales-outreach suppression refresh: daily (6am PT) from HubSpot export; manual override allowed for named accounts via Isabelle.
tab_deliverability_ramp_plan:
Objective: protect sending domain reputation while increasing volume for onboarding v2.
Primary vendor: SendGrid (with domain authentication via DKIM/SPF/DMARC; see INT-3301).

Ramp phases (new onboarding v2 templates):
Phase 0 — Seed + QA (2 business days)
- Send only to internal seed list (~60) + dogfood volunteers.
- Validate rendering (dark mode/mobile), links, unsubscribe, and event logging.
- Acceptance: <2% soft bounce, 0 hard bounce, 0 spam complaints.

Phase 1 — 10% of eligible traffic (2 days)
- Randomized by cohort assignment (feature flag) + region-balanced.
- Monitor: bounce, complaint, open rate, click rate, first_request_success lift.
- Stop condition: spam complaints >=0.08% OR hard bounce >=0.3% in a 24h window.

Phase 2 — 25% of eligible traffic (2 days)
- Continue subject line A/B only; freeze body copy changes.
- Add quiet hours enforcement (send windows only).

Phase 3 — 50% of eligible traffic (3 days)
- Expand to all regions except any with tracking discrepancies (see INT-3310).
- Begin ST1 stalled email only after Phase 3 begins (avoid too many touches early).

Phase 4 — 100% (steady state)
- Promote winning subject line.
- Keep 5% perpetual holdout for long-run incremental measurement (Ben + Mei).

Ongoing hygiene:
- Auto-suppress repeated soft bounces (>=3 in 7 days).
- Daily review of Google Postmaster Tools / vendor reputation dashboard.
- Weekly list hygiene: remove inactive or unknown-unknowns (role addresses, typo domains).

Escalation / owners:
- Deliverability monitoring: Tyler (primary), Ben (backup)
- DNS/auth issues: Internal Support (INT-3301)
- Copy changes during ramp: Soojin review required
- Stop-sends decision: Ben + Camila
tab_qa_checklist_and_monitoring:
Pre-launch checklist (must pass before Phase 1):
- [ ] All templates include unsubscribe + physical address
- [ ] Preference center link works + updates suppression within 15 min
- [ ] UTMs present and correct (utm_campaign=onboarding_v2; utm_content matches email_id)
- [ ] Deep links go to correct console pages (API keys, quickstart, usage dashboard)
- [ ] Event logging: email_sent, email_delivered, email_open (if available), email_click, unsubscribe
- [ ] Dedupe validated (no multiple sends for same email_id)
- [ ] Holdout logic validated (cohort distribution within +/-2%)

Monitoring (daily during ramp, then 2x/week):
- Deliverability: delivery rate, bounce rate, spam complaint rate
- Engagement: open rate (directional), click rate, click-to-open
- Activation: api_key_created rate (D0–D2), first_request_success rate (D0–D7), TTFT
- Support load: count of tickets tagged "didn’t receive onboarding email" (SUP-24871)

Links to dashboards (add in console once live):
- Activation funnel dashboard (observability pack panels)
- Email performance by cohort/region

Open questions / to confirm:
- Whether to suppress all emails for .gov/.mil domains by default (security expectations) — pending Michael/Olga.
- Whether RR1 should include a "book a 15-min setup call" CTA (could be interpreted as sales) — pending Jordan/Stephanie input.
